name: terminal-desk
description: Stats bar above the prompt and a /desk pane. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later; herdr optional. Optional second-model check sends your request and Claude's final report to Haiku.

name: side-chat
description: A side pane for follow-up questions (/btw). macOS only. Sends your question and the main conversation to a model fork; falls back to Haiku.

name: layman
description: Plain-language replies on request. No dependencies; makes no model or network calls.

name: big-read-guard
description: Refuses whole-file Reads of text files over 50 KB. Needs awk.

name: repo-health
description: Read-only health check of a git repo and its GitHub remote: PRs, merged and stale branches, worktrees, stashes. Deletes nothing.

name: web-access
description: Picks the right tool for live web needs, starting with free search and fetch. Needs the treg entry and a treg account.

name: statusline
description: Coloured status line (model, folder, branch, time) built on claude-hud. You add one statusLine line to settings.json yourself.
